description: Show an artboard in the document window: make it active and fit it in the window, fit all artboards, or zoom on its centre (View > Fit Artboard in Window, Fit All in Window)

artboardIndex.description: Artboard index (0-based). Positions are measured from this artboard's top-left corner. Default 0

fit.description: Fit this artboard, or every artboard, in the window. Default artboard unless zoom is given

zoom.description: Instead of fitting: zoom factor centred on the artboard (1 = 100%)

name: view_artboard
title: View Artboard
